inspection: Visually inspected all original generated PNGs. Clean edge-to-edge flat textures with no joints, text, borders or obvious lighting gradients. Seamless tiling was requested; exact seam continuity is not guaranteed by generation.

assets.name: limestone-greige
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless PBR base-color texture for a school architectural game.
Style/medium: photorealistic material surface scan, flat albedo only.
Composition/framing: one square image at least 1024 by 1024 pixels, orthographic straight-on view of only the material; fills the entire image edge to edge. Seamless tile: opposite edges must connect naturally in both axes.
Lighting/mood: perfectly uniform diffuse illumination across the whole image. No directional lighting, no gradients, no cast shadows, no highlights or baked specular reflections.
Constraints: no objects or scenery, no perspective, no text, no logos, no border, no joints, no vignette.
Primary request: smooth neutral light greige limestone for a contemporary school exterior.
Materials/textures: honed smooth face with very subtle fine mineral grain and tiny natural tonal flecks. Pale warm grey beige, restrained low contrast, clean even surface.
Avoid: stone blocks, masonry joints, cracks, damage, dirt, grime, rust, strongly mottled clouds.
